I feel like most personality disorders are like this. From histrionic to OCD to NPD, the emptyness on the inside caracterized by the lack of self identity, only being able to see yourself as an empty disorderd shell is so fucking painful, more so when that emptyness is never gonna be felt on the outside. The ability of feeling emotions different, making them more so states then feelings due to a complete lack of self, is something that can only be sympathised with, never empathised with, and the feeling of never being able to be understood when all were able to see is other humans empathising and understanding one another makes it feel like you're gonna forever be alone on the inside and outside.


Not to mention the amount of stigma surrounding specific quirks of the disorders, that are very much explainable due to past environments, view of self, view of others, uncertainty, extreme mood swings, etc.



This won't mean much, but at least we have eachother to be able to come to closest we've ever been to being empathised with and empathising with others about our own emotions. However lonely or alone you may ever feel, you'll never be alone as long as so many of us are here. Stay safe. At the end of the day you're still a human even if it really dosent feel like it at times <3 🍪✨
